pack.name: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark
pack.description: CIS-aligned GCP hardening themes for architecture review. Grounded in GCP inventory ZIP and Terraform google_* evidence. Not CIS benchmark pass/fail.

rules.title: CIS Microsoft GCP Foundations Benchmark — control theme 1
rules.description: Architecture manifest and GCP extractor evidence should support: cis microsoft gcp foundations benchmark — control theme 1. Thematic mapping only — not certification.
rules.remediationGuidance: Document expectations in governance.PolicyConstraints and governance.RequiredControls; align services[].Tags and datastores[] with reviewer narrative in metadata.ChangeDescription.
